description: Change of use from C3 to C2 Children's home
decision_conditions: <p>Insufficient information has been provided to demonstrate an identified local need for the proposed childcare facility or that it would serve the local community. In addition, no legal agreement has been secured to guarantee priority placements for children within the London Borough of Harrow, meaning the development would not ensure that local childcare needs are met. The proposal therefore represents an inappropriate change of use, contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy H12 of the London Plan (2021), Policy CS1 of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policy DM29 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013), and Policy HO7 of the Harrow's New Local Plan 2021 -2041 (November 2024) .&nbsp;</p>

<p>The proposal results in the loss of existing residential floorspace, and no justification or reprovision has been provided to demonstrate that this loss is acceptable. The development would therefore lead to an unwarranted reduction in the borough’s housing stock, contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies H8 of the London Plan (2021), Policy CS1 of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policy DM24 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and Policy HO1 of the Harrow's New Local Plan 2021 -2041 (November 2024) .&nbsp;</p>
